name: 3-propoxypropylamine
description: 3-Propoxypropylamine (CAS 16728-59-9 ) is a primary amine with an ether-linked propoxy group, used across industrial formulations as a reactive intermediate and functional additive. Its combination of amine reactivity and ether solubility character positions it for corrosion inhibition, pH control, and emulsification duties in demanding process environments. In oil, gas, and water treatment systems, it functions as a corrosion inhibitor and pH buffer, protecting metal infrastructure in aggressive aqueous or hydrocarbon media. Coatings and adhesive formulators incorporate it as a curing agent or reactive diluent, where the primary amine group drives crosslinking with epoxy resins. Lubricant and metalworking fluid manufacturers use it to stabilize emulsions and maintain pH balance under high-load operating conditions for industrial machinery. Pharmaceutical and specialty chemical producers source it as a synthetic building block for active ingredients and functional intermediates requiring an ether-amine scaffold. 3-Propoxypropylamine is supplied as a liquid and is available in technical grade for industrial and formulation applications across various manufacturing sectors. Buyers sourcing for pharmaceutical synthesis should confirm purity specifications and documentation requirements directly with the supplier, as high-purity grades may be available.
